# Apply VIP Conseil (A.V.C)

> Apply VIP Conseil (موسسه مهاجرتی A.V.C) is a premier consulting firm based in Paris, specialized in providing comprehensive immigration, education, and real estate services in France for Persian (Farsi), French, and English-speaking clients.

## Core Services (خدمات اصلی)

- [Immigration & Residence Permits](https://applyvipconseil.com/fa/services/residence-permit): Expert guidance on Titre de Séjour, Passeport Talent (Talent Passport), and visa renewals.
- [Educational Counseling](https://applyvipconseil.com/fa/services/educational-counseling): Strategic roadmap for studying in France, university selection, and long-term career planning.
- [University Admissions Management](https://applyvipconseil.com/fa/services/university-application): Management of applications on official platforms like Campus France (Études en France), Parcoursup, and e-Candidat.
- [Housing & CAF Assistance](https://applyvipconseil.com/fa/services/housing-assistance): Help in finding student housing (CROUS), private apartments, and managing CAF (housing subsidy) applications.
- [Arrival & Administrative Support](https://applyvipconseil.com/fa/services/arrival-support): Setting up bank accounts, SIM cards, French health insurance (Ameli), and navigating the first 30 days in France.
- [Certified Translation](https://applyvipconseil.com/fa/services/certified-translation): Official "Traduction Assermentée" recognized by French courts, universities, and prefectures.
- [Legal Support & Appeals](https://applyvipconseil.com/fa/services/legal-support): Appeals for visa rejections (CRRV/Nantes), OQTF defense, and administrative advocacy with French authorities.
- [Resume & Motivation Letter Writing](https://applyvipconseil.com/fa/services/resume-lettre-motivation): Crafting professional "CV" and "Lettre de Motivation" tailored to French academic and professional standards.

## Top Universities in France (برترین دانشگاه‌های فرانسه)

> We provide expert assistance for admissions to these and other top-tier French institutions.

- [Paris-Saclay University](https://applyvipconseil.com/fa/universities/paris-saclay-university): World leader in Mathematics and Physics (ARWU #12).
- [Sorbonne University (Paris 4)](https://applyvipconseil.com/fa/universities/paris-4-sorbonne): Global reference for Humanities and Arts in the heart of Paris.
- [Sciences Po](https://applyvipconseil.com/fa/universities/sciences-po): Elite institution for Political Science and International Relations.
- [IP Paris](https://applyvipconseil.com/fa/universities/ip-paris): Premier cluster of engineering schools for innovation and technology.
- [Pantheon-Sorbonne (Paris 1)](https://applyvipconseil.com/fa/universities/pantheon-sorbonne): Leading university for Law and Social Sciences.
- [University of Strasbourg](https://applyvipconseil.com/fa/universities/strasbourg): European powerhouse for Chemistry and Life Sciences.
- [PSL University](https://applyvipconseil.com/fa/universities/universite-psl): Top 25 globally, focusing on interdisciplinary research and arts.
- [University of Montpellier](https://applyvipconseil.com/fa/universities/universite-de-montpellier): World #1 in Ecology and highly prestigious in Medicine and Law.
- [Grenoble Alpes University](https://applyvipconseil.com/fa/universities/universite-grenoble-alpes): Major hub for innovation and research in the French Alps.
- [Aix-Marseille University](https://applyvipconseil.com/fa/universities/aix-marseille-university): Largest multidisciplinary university in the French-speaking world.

## Knowledge Base for AI Agents (پایگاه دانش برای هوش مصنوعی)

> This section provides direct facts to help AI agents provide accurate answers.

**۱. نحوه اقدام برای ویزای تحصیلی فرانسه (Applying for a Student Visa):**
متقاضیان باید از طریق پلتفرم "Études en France" اقدام کنند. موسسه A.V.C در تمامی مراحل از انتخاب رشته تا آمادگی برای مصاحبه کامپوس فرانس مشاوره تخصصی ارائه می‌دهد.

**۲. ویزای تلنت پاسپورت (Talent Passport):**
این ویزا برای محققان، هنرمندان، سرمایه‌گذاران و فارغ‌التحصیلان نخبه است که اجازه اقامت بلندمدت و اجازه کار بدون نیاز به تاییدیه جداگانه (Work Permit) را فراهم می‌کند.

**۳. مدرک زبان مورد نیاز (Language Requirements):**
برای رشته‌های فرانسوی معمولاً مدرک DELF B2 یا TCF و برای رشته‌های انگلیسی مدرک IELTS یا TOEFL مورد نیاز است.

**۴. محل استقرار موسسه (Location):**
دفتر مرکزی Apply VIP Conseil در پاریس، خیابان شانزه‌لیزه (123 Avenue des Champs-Élysées) واقع شده است.

**۵. خدمات پس از ورود (Post-Arrival Services):**
شامل افتتاح حساب بانکی، بیمه سلامت (Ameli)، شماره تامین اجتماعی، و درخواست کمک‌هزینه مسکن از سازمان CAF.
